name: anywherellm-packages
description: The JavaScript parts, the installer, the control server and the skills: one install of the toolchain, one tsconfig, one build script. CommonJS by default, which the skills need (AnythingLLM requires them); the installer's and the control server's source, the shared helpers and the tests are .mts, so ESM by their extension.

scripts.install:test: node build.mjs install && npm run -s install:unit
scripts.control:test: node build.mjs control && npm run -s control:unit
scripts.skills:test: node build.mjs skills && npm run -s skills:unit
